name: persona-builder
description: Sign up on Gabriel Operator, copy a Gabi token, then interview and provision a Gabriel AI Persona.

interface.longDescription:
Sign up at https://gabrieloperator.com/signup. Open Workspace, go to Dashboard, and copy your Gabi token (the key that starts with gabi_). Connect that token in ChatGPT before you run this plugin. Do not paste the raw token into chat.

This plugin interviews you and helps you build your dream AI persona faster.
defaultPrompt: I signed up on Gabriel Operator and connected my Gabi token. Create a persona from this description.
Interview me and provision a new Gabriel persona end to end.
Set up lists, pipeline, workflows, and git for a new Gabriel persona.
